# Introduction

This file is entirely in English. Use it to assert that the detector
labels single-language files appropriately when mixed profile is
enabled with allowed_source_languages including `en`.

## Section in English

When you click the button, the system sends a request and waits for
the response. The response carries the user object, including the
configured preferences.

```yaml
endpoint: /api/v1/session
method: GET
```

> The block above is technical literal and must not be translated.
